import subprocess

from datetime import datetime, timezone
dt = datetime.fromisoformat("2026-03-10T09:00:00-05:00")
print(f"tzinfo: {dt.tzinfo}")
print(f"astimezone(utc): {dt.astimezone(timezone.utc)}")

import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(["python3", "test_iso.py"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout)
print(result.stderr)

from datetime import datetime, timezone
dt = datetime.fromisoformat("2026-03-10T09:00:00-05:00")
print(f"Original: {dt}, tz: {dt.tzinfo}")
dt_str = str(dt)
print(f"String: {dt_str}")
dt_parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(dt_str)
print(f"Parsed: {dt_parsed}, tz: {dt_parsed.tzinfo}")
print(f"UTC: {dt_parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc)}")
